data.description:

Mathias Paladino has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, starting with Esprinet’s robust first-half performance and significantly raised full-year EBITDA guidance, while keeping the price target unchanged at $8.8. Growth is now supported by multiple business segments, including V-Valley and the recovering core Devices activities, alongside better working capital and lower net debt, which together strengthen the investment case and justify maintaining a Buy recommendation at the $8.8 price target.

data.title: Verastem: Avutometinib Plus Defactinib Data De-Risk Efficacy Thesis; Buy Rating Reiterated With Unchanged $18 Price Target
data.description:
In a report released today, Andres Y. Maldonado from H.C. Wainwright reiterated a Buy rating on Verastem, with a price target of $18.00.

Andres Y. Maldonado has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to the strength of avutometinib plus defactinib in LGSOC. The newly presented comparative analysis shows that, even after adjusting for key baseline differences, the combination delivers a markedly lower risk of disease progression or death and substantially longer progression-free survival than commonly used therapies, across both KRAS-mutant and KRAS wild-type populations.

He views these results as meaningfully de-risking Verastem’s core efficacy thesis and as a supportive, directional readthrough for the ongoing Phase 3 RAMP 301 trial. In particular, the robust benefit in KRAS-mutant patients and the clinically significant improvement in outcomes for KRAS wild-type disease underpin the potential for label expansion into a much larger commercial population, justifying the continued Buy rating and the unchanged $18 price target.
